title: CustomMetric
description: A custom metric data point to upload to the Controller through the Machine Agent HTTP listener.

metricName.description: The full metric path name using pipe delimiters for hierarchy levels. For example, Custom Metrics|MyApp|RequestCount.

aggregatorType.description: The aggregation type that determines how metric values are rolled up across time periods and cluster nodes.

value.description: The metric value as a 64-bit integer.
